# Batch B001 — agents/code-reviewer.md and .claude/capabilities/** (contracts and module manifests)
# Capability CONTRACT/MODULE files are declared 'maintainer metadata, not auto-loaded'. Their JSON blocks are
# nevertheless read by executable checks: MODULE.md manifests by lib/common.js loadSelectedModules() (used by
# check-manifests.js, check-architecture.js, stop.js, check-instructions.js); CONTRACT.md JSON by check-instructions.js.

@@ output/template/.claude/agents/code-reviewer.md ;; Subagent definition (delegated review); frontmatter is effective configuration.
@scope subagent code-reviewer
1-6 IM ;; Frontmatter: name and delegation description (trigger text).
7 OL [wf010.reviewer-readonly] ;; ;; disallowedTools: Write, Edit, MultiEdit, NotebookEdit
8-9 OL [wf010.reviewer-skill] ;; ;; - code-review
10 IM ;; Frontmatter close.
12 NN ;; Banner (thin read-only wrapper; code-review owns criteria).
14 NN ;; Heading.
16 OL [wf010.reviewer-readonly] ;; ;; Perform an independent, read-only review. Do not edit files.
18-20 OL [wf010.reviewer-skill]
22 OL [wf010.reviewer-output]

C wf010.reviewer-readonly OL WF-010 MUST_NOT ;; The code-reviewer performs an independent read-only review: Write, Edit, MultiEdit and NotebookEdit are disallowed and it must not edit files. ;; = ;; Shell tools are not disallowed by frontmatter. ;;
C wf010.reviewer-skill OL WF-010 MUST ;; Use the code-review workflow as the canonical procedure (preloaded; read SKILL.md if not in context); do not redefine review policy. ;; = ;; none ;;
C wf010.reviewer-output OL WF-010 MUST ;; Return findings in the code-review workflow's output shape. ;; = ;; none ;;

@scope capability maintenance (contract read during capability maintenance; JSON enforced by check-instructions.js)
1 NN ;; Banner declaring maintainer metadata, not auto-loaded.
3 NN ;; Heading.
5 NN ;; Heading.
7-9 NN ;; Purpose description of the frame.
10-11 EX [x.cap-placement-frame] ;; ;; Binding rule: placement belongs to the frame; technique belongs
13 NN ;; Heading.
15-16 NN ;; Table header.
17-25 NN ;; Role vocabulary definitions (terminology used by other instructions).
27-28 EX [x.cap-binds-required]
30 NN ;; Heading.
32-33 NN ;; Table header.
34-37 NN ;; Facet table describing locations/loading (descriptive; enforced via the JSON block below).
39 NN ;; Heading.
41-44 EX [x.cap-frame-replacement]
46-47 IM ;; JSON block start and slot identity.
48-58 EX [x.cap-contract-conformance] ;; Contract JSON: required facets, properties, enforcement data and roles that check-instructions.js validates for the selected frame module.
59-60 IM ;; JSON block end.

C x.cap-placement-frame EX - MUST ;; Placement belongs to the architecture frame; technique belongs to leaf capabilities. ;; = ;; none ;; Capability-system ownership rule (repo/meta), not an oracle policy.
C x.cap-binds-required EX - MUST ;; A leaf that must name a frame-specific project or directory declares a binds entry in its manifest (enforced by check-instructions.js). ;; = ;; none ;; Capability-system rule (repo/meta).
C x.cap-frame-replacement EX ARC-020 MUST ;; A replacement frame must supply every role mapping and facet; a frame replacement reviews embedded rules that use layer names. ;; = ;; Only on frame replacement. ;; Capability replacement procedure not in the oracle.
C x.cap-contract-conformance EX - ENFORCED ;; Selected modules must provide every contract-required facet at the role-named location, every required property and every required enforcement data entry (check-instructions.js errors otherwise). ;; = ;; none ;; Capability conformance invariant (repo/meta).

@@ output/template/.claude/capabilities/architecture/clean-architecture/MODULE.md ;; Selected frame module manifest (not auto-loaded); JSON consumed by check-architecture.js, check-manifests.js, stop.js and check-instructions.js.
@scope executable data of the selected architecture module (consumed by hooks/checkers)
1 NN ;; Banner.
3 NN ;; Heading.
5-8 NN ;; Description of the module and what it supplies.
10-11 NN ;; States runtime facets live in flat locations.
13 NN ;; Heading.
15-29 IM ;; JSON: slot/implementation identity, facet locations and property pointers (validated by check-instructions.js).
30 IM ;; binds: none.
31 EX [x.cap-leak-tokens] ;; ;; "leakTokens": ["Clean Architecture", "clean-architecture"],
32-33 EX [x.cap-detail-tokens] ;; ;; "detailTokens": ["Infrastructure", ".Domain", ".Application", ".Api"],
34 OL [arc009.reserved-packages] ;; ;; "reservedPackages": ["MediatR", "Kommand"],
35-37 IM ;; JSON structure: architecture specification header and project root 'backend'.
38-42 OL [arc001.layer-matrix] ;; Layer suffixes and allowed references (Domain none; Application→Domain; Infrastructure→Application, Domain; Api→Application, Infrastructure, Domain).
43-48 OL [arc028.test-matrix] ;; Test-project suffixes and allowed references (IntegrationTests→Api only).
49-52 OL [arc008.forbidden-namespaces] ;; Core model and use-case layer must not import Microsoft.AspNetCore or persistence technology namespaces.
53-57 IM ;; Owner pointer and JSON block end.

C x.cap-leak-tokens EX - ENFORCED ;; Instruction and enforcement files outside a capability's own facets must not name a selected implementation's leak tokens (e.g. Clean Architecture, NUnit, Angular, EF Core) unless a binds entry declares it; check-instructions.js reports errors. ;; = ;; Owning facets, MAP.md and capability-selection.md exempt; binds entries. ;; Implementation-name isolation is a capability-system invariant (repo/meta), not an oracle policy.
C x.cap-detail-tokens EX - ENFORCED ;; Non-frame capability facets must not use frame-specific names (Infrastructure, .Domain, .Application, .Api) without a binds entry to the frame. ;; = ;; binds to the frame. ;; Capability-system invariant (repo/meta).
C arc009.reserved-packages OL ARC-009,ARC-020 ENFORCED_ADVISORY ;; MediatR and Kommand package references are flagged (WARN) as not-adopted patterns requiring a Reserved decision. ;; = ;; Approved decision. ;;
C arc001.layer-matrix OL ARC-001 ENFORCED ;; Backend project references are checked against the frame matrix (Domain→none, Application→Domain, Infrastructure→Application/Domain, Api→Application/Infrastructure/Domain); violations are errors. ;; = ;; Projects matched by suffix under backend/. ;;
C arc028.test-matrix OL ARC-028 ENFORCED_ADVISORY ;; Test-project references are checked against allowed lists (Domain.Tests→Domain; Application.Tests→Application, Domain; Infrastructure.Tests→Infrastructure, Application, Domain; IntegrationTests→Api); broader references are warnings. ;; = ;; none ;;
C arc008.forbidden-namespaces OL ARC-002,ARC-008,ARC-019 ENFORCED ;; Code in the core model (Domain) and use-case layer (Application) must not import Microsoft.AspNetCore or Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore namespaces (errors). ;; = ;; none ;;
